body.en:
Question B-006-006-002.

Why the correct answer is right: An antenna tuner transforms impedance so the transceiver can work into a mismatched antenna system.

Per-choice notes:
- sourceIndex 0: "It matches a transceiver to a mismatched antenna system": Correct. An antenna tuner transforms impedance so the transceiver can work into a mismatched antenna system.
- sourceIndex 1: "It helps a receiver automatically tune in stations that are far away": Those functions belong to receiver tuning or switching, not impedance matching.
- sourceIndex 2: "It switches an antenna system to a transmitter when sending, and to a receiver when listening": Those functions belong to receiver tuning or switching, not impedance matching.
- sourceIndex 3: "It switches multiple transceivers to a common transmission line and antenna": Those functions belong to receiver tuning or switching, not impedance matching.
